query:
UPDATE sales 
SET saleDate = CONCAT('2025-12-31 ', DATE_FORMAT(saleDate, '%H:%i:%s'))
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND YEAR(saleDate) = 2026
  AND MONTH(saleDate) = 1
  AND DAY(saleDate) IN (1, 3)
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
